description: Na₄CoO₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are four inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to four O²⁻ atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.33 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O²⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.27 Å. In the third Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to four O²⁻ atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.69 Å. In the fourth Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four O²⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.48 Å. Co²⁺ is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O²⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.80-1.90 Å. There are three inequivalent O²⁻ sites. In the first O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to five Na¹⁺ and one Co²⁺ atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Co octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-61°. In the second O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to five Na¹⁺ and one Co²⁺ atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Co octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-58°. In the third O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na¹⁺ and one Co²⁺ atom.
